description: Advanced PDF manipulation module with comprehensive business document generation, analysis, and optimization capabilities written in Go and compiled to WebAssembly.

errorHandling.description: PDF module returns objects with 'error' field when operations fail, with detailed error messages and operation context
errorHandling.detection: if (result.error) { console.error('PDF error:', result.error); } else { /* use result data */ }
